verdict.rationale: Relay supports outgoing international wires, which its docs say 'can send same-day' with a delivery estimate shown before confirming. A community review calls the international transfer system easy to use, at $10 per outgoing transfer (waived on Pro). Nothing shows delivery in under a minute, so the story's defining speed element is not met. Missing for 10: evidence of sub-minute or instant international delivery, any real-time cross-border rail, and independent confirmation of actual international arrival times.
